title: Keep the £1 million limit on business asset relief
headline: Keep the £1m relief limit. Costs £0.3bn in 2029-30.
description: The lifetime limit on gains that get Business Asset Disposal Relief halves from £1 million to £500,000 from April 2027, so gains above it pay the main rates. Switch this on to keep the £1 million limit.

baselinePolicy.text: The lifetime limit of Business Asset Disposal Relief is £500,000 from 6 April 2027 (Table 6.1 line 60).

source.quote: This measure reduces the lifetime limit of the Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR) to £500,000 worth of qualifying gains

alreadyIncludes: The lifetime limit of Business Asset Disposal Relief is £500,000 from 6 April 2027 (Table 6.1 line 60).

lines.title: Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR): Reduce the lifetime limit to £500,000 from 6 April 2027

rawSource.note: Reversal: the Treasury’s costing with its sign reversed (positive scorecard values reduce borrowing; here receipts positive means more revenue).

caveats: The Treasury’s costing is on the OBR October 2026 forecast, the baseline used here. Effects before the start year are not applied: 2026-27 falls before any Budget of yours.

considerations.text: The Treasury’s scorecard figure is the certified direct costing for the measure, including the behavioural response the Treasury and OBR agreed; the Budget 2026 policy costings document gives the method.
